name: t-redwoods
eval: bend.set('redwoods', { hour: 19.4, dayGoes: false }); bend.set('camera', { followDist: 3.6, followFov: 44, followPitch: 0.1, followSwing: 0 }); bend.wake(); bend.place(0,-0.8,0,Math.PI/2); bend.place(1,0.8,0,-Math.PI/2); await bend.step(200); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.3 });
